sentences.text: The only known fossil of Guildavis is a tiny, crushed fragment of the sacrum.
The fossil was discovered in 1879 by Edgar W. Guild in Kansas.
Guildavis is classified as an ornithuran avialan and belongs to the parent group Ornithurae.
It is more closely related to modern birds than its original genus, Ichthyornis.
Guildavis lived during the Late Cretaceous period in the Niobrara Formation of Kansas.
